previous_statement: For X=V, let iota_V:B_V -> q_V B_R q_V be the canonical coordinate map iota_V(b_V)=(0,b_V), a linear bijection with inverse (0,b_V) |-> b_V. The diagonal level-one map produced in the explicit datum of 1.2 is the outer-compressed map T_V=Co^{A_R}_{P_V^R} o Co^A_{P_R} o v_V from lem-maincb-outer-compression-transfer. That external result, applied to the outer-compression instance certified by the construction in lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum, makes T_V an extended isomorphism and hence a bijection by def-extended-delta-inclusion. The displayed definition gives gamma_VV o iota_V=T_V, so gamma_VV is bijective and is exactly the fixed V,V map of the datum.
new_statement: The fixed V,V level-one map in the datum of 1.2 is the displayed gamma_VV, and gamma_VV is bijective.
